description: Search catalog offers (promotions and listed products) from Danish retail chains. Returns ONLY currently-valid offers unless include_expired is set. Filter by chain slug, product id, or EAN. Offers carry chainId — resolve names via list_chains. Self-serve keys see published campaign offers (tilbudsaviser, month-campaigns) only — not everyday shelf prices, which are Salling-only and restricted to partner keys.

ean.description: Filter to offers matched to this EAN-13.

include_expired.description: Include offers past their validity window. Default: false.

product_id.description: Filter to offers matched to this product id.

name: search_catalog_offers
